hypothesis_text: An unbroken 15-minute pullback and EMA20 reclaim within a rising completed 4-hour trend has positive net value under fixed common execution and costs.

entry.higher_rule: Latest completed UTC 4h close > EMA20 > EMA60, and EMA20 > previous completed 4h EMA20.
entry.A: Previous completed bar: low <= EMA20 and close <= EMA20.
entry.B: Immediately following completed bar: close > EMA20, close > A.high, and low >= A.low.
entry.event_identity: symbol, long, A.close_time; one observation per decision bar
entry.expiry: Only the immediately following B qualifies; no waiting, reuse, or discretionary confirmation.
entry.execution_intent: First UTC 15m opening boundary strictly after actual local first observation; never the signal close.
entry.unavailable_or_invalid_feature: Record rejection; never substitute a future bar or zero.

execution_scope: Hypothetical research account only; these values are not user account terms or production risk settings. Same existing lifecycle and capacity constraints for candidate and baseline; 1R full exit ordinarily precedes the 2R target. Tail positions are marked rather than silently liquidated.
cost_scope: Fees are frozen per-fill notional assumptions, not verified actual account rates. Slippage is separate. Actual public historical settlements use signed held quantity, settlement mark price and rate. Missing funding does not become zero.
baseline: Original ProjectSignalEngine at initialization, same frozen BTC/ETH inputs, long-only opportunity scope, identical execution and cost scenarios. No retrospective candidate filtering or unrelated portfolio comparison.

forward_boundary.freeze: SYSTEM time when manifest, exact protocol bytes, sanitized baseline strategy configuration and all execution/source code hashes are frozen.
forward_boundary.warmup: Initial 300 complete 15m and 4h bars only initialize state. Historical data, including newly downloaded old dates, never becomes a prospective signal.
forward_boundary.new_data: Only timely, first-observed completed bars after freeze, with prior warmup and full raw source envelopes, can enter confirmation.
forward_boundary.gaps: Missing observations and late/backfilled bars remain explicit. They cannot be relabeled forward or silently removed to obtain a pass.
forward_boundary.revision: Previously committed raw completed bars cannot be replaced.
forward_boundary.clock_scope: Local receive time records first availability to this collector, not an asserted Binance publication timestamp.
forward_boundary.end: Initialization SYSTEM time plus exactly 12 weeks; fixed horizon, no optional stopping or PnL selection before the end.
forward_boundary.timely_definition: Last completed 15m bar has close_time < actual observation <= close_time+90000ms; all source responses were received by that observation.

primary_evaluation.measure: One synchronized continuous research account per variant/scenario; net marked equity, actual funding, fees, fills, rejections and close-to-close maximum drawdown.
research_screen: TPR1 base account net return > matched baseline base account net return
primary_evaluation.threshold_origin: Predeclared research continuation screen proposed for this task; not a profitability certification or a replacement for the existing project promotion gates.
primary_evaluation.inconclusive: Before deadline, insufficient trades, any unresolved observation/source/price/funding gap, code or protocol drift, or test-clock inputs cannot pass.
primary_evaluation.dependence: BTC and ETH and adjacent/overlapping signals are dependent. Do not use raw trade counts as independent observations or claim significance from these screen inequalities.
primary_evaluation.pass_action: Only consider further independent statistical and execution review; account_verified remains false and automatic promotion is forbidden.
primary_evaluation.fail_action: Retain all outputs; stop this expression without expanding a parameter grid.
primary_evaluation.blinding: Intermediate status reports observation coverage, missingness and signal counts only; no intermediate candidate ranking or PnL.
primary_evaluation.insufficient_trades_definition: No completed candidate trade or no completed matched-baseline trade prevents a relative research screen. No fixed trade count establishes a profitable edge; uncertainty and sparse participation remain reported.

weekly_uncertainty.method: Paired non-circular moving blocks of two consecutive weeks, resampled jointly for candidate and baseline; descriptive intervals only.
weekly_uncertainty.weekly_origin: Start of the synchronized scoring calendar; segments do not reset capital.

previous_attempts: Existing V1 volume sequence, C1 strict candidate lifecycle and C2 net-R/R filtering were already explored and did not establish a profitable strategy.
T28/T84 weekly trend allocation remains a different frozen research project.
The latest 34 retained linear-accounting trades and earlier research have been inspected. None belongs to this candidate's new confirmation set.

scope_limits.universe: BTC/ETH research coverage only; no extrapolation to the production top-100 pool.
scope_limits.local_collector: Runs on this workstation while available; interruption is recorded as missing observation evidence, not hidden by a historical replay.

funding_coverage.scope: Predeclared coverage assumption for the fixed BTC/ETH pool; not a guarantee of future exchange schedules.
funding_coverage.gate: Every scheduled 8h slot in [scoring_start,scoring_end) must have exactly one valid official symbol-matching record within 60000ms of that slot. Preserve actual source settlement time for cash flow; never round it. Pagination exhaustion alone is insufficient. Duplicate, missing, out-of-tolerance or unexpected settlements block evaluation; missing funding is never zero.
funding_coverage.interval_change: If the official settlement schedule changes, retain evidence and return INCONCLUSIVE; no post-result schedule substitution.
funding_coverage.tolerance_origin: Predeclared source-clock tolerance; recent official BTC/ETH records include timestamps a few milliseconds after the UTC slot.
